text: **dsh-nico-theme**（DSH 网页客户端主题插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 换上可开关的液态玻璃视觉层。它通过主题 token、界面插槽和 CSS/画布效果覆盖顶栏、侧栏、输入区、弹窗及对话阅读区域，并提供独立设置页。主要功能包括 Mica 与兼容显示模式、流体或图片/视频壁纸、玻璃折射与模糊调节、悬停弹性动效和对话阅读衬底。适合希望自定义 DSH 网页界面外观的用户；设置保存在浏览器本地，无需 API Key 或外部账号。

**dsh-nico-theme** is a switchable liquid-glass theme for DSH. It styles interface panels and chats, with a settings page for Mica or compatibility mode, glass blur and refraction, and fluid or custom wallpapers. Preferences stay in browser storage; no API key is needed.

Can I use my own video as the chat background in DSH?
dsh-nico-theme 的功能「主题开关与显示模式」：在内置插件页可启用或关闭玻璃主题，并可选择 Mica 面板模式或保留原布局的兼容模式。关闭后撤销主题效果。
dsh-nico-theme 的功能「材质参数调节」：专属设置页提供模糊、亮度、折射、深度、曲率、色散和高光等控制，可调整玻璃面板的视觉质感。
dsh-nico-theme 的功能「流体或自选壁纸」：用户可在设置页选择流体背景或自选壁纸，并配置色调、深度、模糊等参数；壁纸路径由客户端设置状态管理。
dsh-nico-theme 的功能「对话阅读区域样式」：主题层为对话内容挂载阅读衬底效果，并允许在设置中调整衬底透明度和模糊程度。

dsh-nico-theme README · dsh-nico-theme：A switchable **liquid-glass** theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) web UI. Header, sidebar, composer, docks, and conversation pads become frosted panes over a living fluid backdrop (image or video wallpaper is optional). Turning the plugin off restores the stock UI — no DSH source changes.

dsh-nico-theme README · What it is：A DSH client plugin. The panel glass is rendered by [nico-glass-kit](https://github.com/more-nico/nico-glass-kit): every pane portals a `GlassSurface`, whose backdrop runs an SVG displacement filter, so the glass bends the picture along its rounded corners instead of only blurring it. The fluid backdrop, wallpaper layers and reading pads are this repo's own CSS/canvas work. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

dsh-nico-theme README · Highlights：- **Mica** floating glass panels (32px main-panel corners, 18px popup corners, nico-glass-kit material), or **compat** mode (stock layout, frosted material)
- Panes cover the header, sidebar, composer, docks, dialogs, menus, model lists, background-task popover and new-session capsule, including multiple transient panels of the same kind
- Popups start with configured frosting before refraction becomes ready; panes share the material settings, with a stronger neutral tint on the right sidebar for file previews. Selected rows, header tabs and small buttons use rounded outlines and subtle highlights
- Fluid backdrop with hue / depth knobs; optional image or video wallpaper with its own blur slider
- Material knobs on the kit scale: blur, brightness, refraction, depth, curvature, dispersion, rim highlight
- Hover **elasticity**: the glass, icons and panel content lean together using the shared setting; the settings window stays stationary, and `prefers-reduced-motion` turns motion off
- Reading pads for user bubbles, assistant prose, reply actions and the trajectory
- No adaptive text color

The panel glass — refraction, bevel, tint, rim light, and elasticity — is rendered by [nico-glass-kit](https://github.com/more-nico/nico-glass-kit) (`0.3.4`, MIT). The fluid backdrop, wallpaper layers, and reading pads are this repository's own CSS/canvas work.

dsh-nico-theme README · Requirements：- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` (tested version)
- Node.js 22+
- The refraction pass wants a Chromium browser; Firefox and Safari fall back to the kit's plain CSS frost on their own

dsh-nico-theme README · Install：DSH plugins live on a **profile**, not in the global `dsh` install. `dsh plugin add` runs pnpm inside that profile and, because this package declares `dsh.bundle`, **appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically**. Then restart the profile.

dsh-nico-theme README · Daily Web UI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nico-theme@latest
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Enable **Nico glass theme** in Settings → Built-in Plugins → Nico Theme. Every knob lives on the dedicated **Nico Theme** page in the settings left nav.

dsh-nico-theme README · Run only when creating this profile for the first time.：dsh --profile nico-theme-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile nico-theme-test add dsh-nico-theme@latest
dsh --profile nico-theme-test --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18765 --no-open
```

Update later with the same command (`@latest`) or `dsh plugin --profile web update`. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-nico-theme`.
